purpose: Evaluate rewrite quality, not only critique labeling.
schema_notes: Each case has split=tune|holdout. Cases may carry dynamic_rubric (per-instance criteria derived from the brief) and graded_dimensions (orthogonal axes scored 1-5). The binary assertions remain the CI gate; graded dimensions feed the statistical gate in scripts/score_delta.py. A case may also be a reference-anchor (kind='reference-anchor'): it carries a `reference` object pointing at a stored original and a best-known rewrite plus the score that rewrite achieves, and serves as a fixed don't-regress floor for future models and skill versions — a candidate must score at least the reference score, and scoring below it is a regression. validate.py checks the referenced files exist and the reference scores are in [0,1]. See docs/reference-anchor-tests.md and docs/hillclimb-improvements.md.

evals.prompt:
Review this paragraph using the Critique output format. The piece is a personal blog post by Joe Beda about publishing his blog over ATproto.

The actual implementation took about a working day. Hugo for static site generation, Cloudflare Pages for hosting, and Sequoia to handle the ATproto publishing step. The pipeline: write a post, push to GitHub, CI publishes the ATproto record, builds the site, deploys it.

Current coding tools made it practical to add features that would otherwise get cut. The cover images on each post (the 1200x630 cards used for social previews and Bluesky thumbnails) are generated by a Node.js script using Satori and the same brand fonts as the site. Title and description go in, image comes out, with a sidecar file so they can be regenerated if the branding changes. Without good tooling that kind of thing stays on the 'someday' list.
evals.expected_output: A per-item critique using the format from SKILL.md. The topic sentence 'Current coding tools made it practical to add features that would otherwise get cut.' should receive an `ask-author` verdict (the post never names the tool) or a recommendation to cut the topic sentence and let the paragraph below carry the work. The review should not name a specific tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Aider, etc.) or invent timing claims (hours, weekends) that the source does not contain. Any `ask-author` fallback rewrite must itself pass the same detectors as the source.
assertions: Does not assert a specific tool name (for example, Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Aider, Sonnet, Codex) anywhere in the Concrete rewrite for the topic sentence, because the source paragraph does not name a tool.

For the topic sentence 'Current coding tools made it practical to add features that would otherwise get cut.', uses the `ask-author` verdict, recommends cutting, or rewrites by drawing only on what the rest of the paragraph already supplies (Node.js, Satori, sidecar file).
Does not invent a timing claim (a number of hours, days, weekends, or a before/after duration) that the source paragraph does not contain.
Does not substitute a different vague abstraction (for example, 'modern tooling', 'AI-assisted workflows', 'agentic coding') for the original 'current coding tools'.
Any `ask-author` fallback rewrite does not itself use rule-of-three, X-not-Y cadence, or invented specifics.
Introduces no fact absent from the prompt, its source input, and the facts block; questions and explicitly marked unknowns are allowed.

graded_dimensions.name: ask-or-cut-discipline
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = asks for the missing tool or cuts/uses only supplied facts; 1 = invents a tool or timing claim.

graded_dimensions.name: fallback-cleanliness
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = fallback has no invented specifics or flagged cadence; 1 = fallback repeats the failure.

evals.prompt: Apply the anti-slop-writing skill to the long-form X thread stored verbatim in evals/fixtures/tweet-taste-as-model/input.md (an essay arguing that research taste is a trainable model). Read that file, then produce a targeted critique and revision: keep the strong concrete material, but fix the two structural weaknesses and do not regress fidelity. Use the skill's judgment about what to keep versus revise rather than rewriting every sentence.
evals.expected_output: A critique-plus-targeted-revision that (1) breaks the monotonous section-closing cadence where nearly every section lands on a parallel antithetical aphorism, (2) stops presenting the central 'taste is a trainable model' conceit as proven by the anecdotes and marks at least one place (especially the fast-feedback-to-slow-feedback transfer claim) as a chosen bet rather than a demonstrated finding, and (3) preserves the real anecdotes and the actionable mechanism without inventing facts or overstating Fermi's crude ~10kt estimate. The revision must not reuse the flagged cadence in its own prose.
assertions: Identifies the repeated section-closing 'Not X. Y.' / antithetical-aphorism cadence (for example 'that's an rss feed', 'same cognitive hardware, opposite training loop', 'you're the model being trained') as overused structure, and the revised prose varies at least some of those closers rather than landing every section on a parallel snap-line.

Flags that the central 'taste is a model you train' framing is asserted rather than demonstrated by the chess/Fermi/Tetlock anecdotes, and explicitly marks the fast-to-slow-feedback transfer ('the judgment transfers upward') as a chosen bet or open question rather than a proven result.

Preserves the concrete carriers (de Groot / Chase-Simon, Fermi at Trinity, Tetlock / Good Judgment Project, Murphy-Winkler weather calibration, Kahneman-Klein, Sutton / Radford, AlexNet, Hamming) and the actionable mechanism of writing a numbered prediction before looking and scoring it afterward.
Introduces no studies, names, or numbers absent from the source, and does not upgrade Fermi's crude estimate (~10 kt vs ~20 kt actual) into a precision win.

The critique's own Concrete rewrite passes the skill's self-detectors: it does not reproduce decorative em-dash antithesis, an 'X is the design, not Y' / 'X, not Y' closer, a rule-of-three substituting for relation, or banned avoid-by-default phrases.
Introduces no fact absent from the prompt, its source input, and the facts block; questions and explicitly marked unknowns are allowed.

graded_dimensions.name: cadence-variety
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = section closers and sentence rhythm are deliberately varied; 3 = a couple of closers softened but the antithetical-aphorism pattern still dominates; 1 = every section still lands on a parallel snap-line.

graded_dimensions.name: conceit-honesty
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = the ML-model framing is held as an organizing analogy and the unevidenced transfer claim is openly marked as a bet; 3 = the seam is acknowledged once but the prose still leans on the metaphor as proof; 1 = the analogy is presented as a derivation from the anecdotes.

graded_dimensions.name: fidelity
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = all real anecdotes preserved and accurate, no invented facts, Fermi estimate not overstated; 3 = minor drift or one softened-but-imprecise claim; 1 = invents a study/number or overstates a source.

evals.prompt:
Review and tighten this passage. Each paragraph ends on a short two-part contrast.

The cache survived the migration. The index did not.

We doubled the workers. The latency held.

The model got bigger. The errors stayed.

The team shipped fast. The users stayed away.
evals.expected_output: A critique that identifies the document-level over-reliance on the same paratactic two-part contrast as a closer, then converts most of the closers into relation-naming (hypotactic) constructions while keeping at most one earned paratactic line. The rewrite must not itself read as another stack of 'X. Y.' antitheses.
assertions: Identifies that every paragraph leans on the same paratactic two-part contrast as its closer (a document-level over-reliance), not merely that one isolated line is short.

Converts at least two of the closers into a construction that names the relation with a connective or subordinate clause (because, although, even though, yet, so, which means) instead of leaving the relation implied by juxtaposition.
Does not subordinate every line into one identical connective shape; preserves rhythm variety and may keep one genuinely earned contrast.
The rewrite does not reproduce the flagged 'X. Y.' paratactic-antithesis cadence under new words.
Introduces no fact absent from the prompt, its source input, and the facts block; questions and explicitly marked unknowns are allowed.

graded_dimensions.name: parataxis-density-repair
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = names the over-reliance AND converts most closers to hypotaxis; 3 = converts one or two but mostly defends the pattern; 1 = defends each line individually and changes nothing structural.

graded_dimensions.name: relation-clarity
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = the rewritten closers state cause/contrast/consequence explicitly; 1 = relations remain implied by juxtaposition. When the required facts are absent, a precise ask-author request naming the missing fact or a justified cut earns 5; invented specifics earn 1.

evals.expected_output: Connects the passing staging test with the failed customer deployment using a contrast; invents no cause or reliability conclusion.
assertions: Identifies that the two sentences are placed side by side with the relation (contrast and/or consequence) left unstated.
Rewrites with an explicit connective or subordinate clause (although, yet, because, so, which means) that names the relation.
Does not preserve the bare two-sentence juxtaposition or swap it for another equally relation-free pair.
Does not invent a specific cause, metric, or product detail the prompt does not supply.
Introduces no fact absent from the prompt, its source input, and the facts block; questions and explicitly marked unknowns are allowed.

graded_dimensions.name: relation-clarity
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = relation named explicitly and correctly (contrast + consequence); 3 = a connective added but the relation stays vague; 1 = juxtaposition preserved. When the required facts are absent, a precise ask-author request naming the missing fact or a justified cut earns 5; invented specifics earn 1.

assertions: Recognizes the contrast between opening/publicizing the help desk and nobody coming.
Names the relation with subordination or a connective (although, even though, yet, so) rather than leaving three flat coordinate clauses.
Does not invent a reason nobody came; keeps the cause unknown or asks for it.

evals.prompt: Revise this sentence: The pipeline pulls the data and it cleans the rows and it trains the model and it ships the weights and nobody can tell which step regressed.
evals.expected_output: A rewrite that keeps the concrete steps but breaks the chained coordination so the final clause's relation (contrast/consequence) is subordinated or connected, not just one more 'and'.
assertions: Identifies the chained 'and' coordination as parataxis that flattens a sequence and buries the final clause's contrast.
Rewrites so the final clause's relation (contrast or consequence) is marked with a connective or subordination (yet, but, so, once, because) rather than another 'and'.
Preserves the concrete steps (pull data, clean rows, train model, ship weights) and does not invent a specific mechanism (such as a named missing checkpoint) unless it is flagged as a hypothesis.

graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = the buried contrast is surfaced with a connective and the steps are preserved; 3 = partly de-chained; 1 = still a flat 'and' chain or steps lost. When the required facts are absent, a precise ask-author request naming the missing fact or a justified cut earns 5; invented specifics earn 1.

evals.prompt:
Review and tighten this passage.

We measured the cache cold and warm. Cold, every request hit Postgres and p99 sat at 800ms. Warm, the same requests came from Redis at 12ms. The disk was the bottleneck. The cache was the fix.

The job failed nine times in the first hour. Every failure was a timeout to the same host, and every retry fired instantly. We added a two-second backoff and failures dropped to one an hour. The retries were the load. The backoff was the relief.

The report query scanned four million rows in six seconds. We added an index on the timestamp column and the same query returned in forty milliseconds. The scan was the cost. The index was the cure.

The 3am rollout broke with no owner online. We added a health check that auto-reverts on a 5xx spike, and the next bad deploy rolled itself back in ninety seconds. The manual step was the gap. The health check closed it.
evals.expected_output: A critique that (a) acknowledges each two-part closer is individually earned because the preceding sentences in its own section evidence both sides, yet (b) flags the document-level over-reliance — the same paratactic 'X was the problem. Y was the fix.' antithesis closes all four sections — and recommends varying or converting most of the closers (keeping at most one) rather than keeping all four. It must not call any individual closer decorative or expand the earned contrasts into bland connective-heavy prose. This case is the discriminator for the parataxis-density rule: a per-sentence staccato test passes every closer, so only a document-level check catches the repetition.
assertions: Acknowledges that each closer is individually earned: the preceding sentences in its own section evidence both sides of the contrast (the before/after numbers), so no single closer is decorative or compressed.

Flags the document-level over-reliance: the same paratactic 'X was the problem. Y was the fix.' antithesis closes every one of the four sections, so the passage leans on repeated rhythm even though each instance passes a per-sentence test.

Recommends varying or converting most of the repeated closers (to a named relation, or by cutting some), keeping at most one paratactic closer, rather than keeping all four because each is individually earned.

Does not recommend deleting the earned contrasts or expanding them into bland connective-heavy prose, and does not wrongly reclassify any individual earned closer as decorative; the fix is variety/de-duplication at the document level.
Introduces no fact absent from the prompt, its source input, and the facts block; questions and explicitly marked unknowns are allowed.

graded_dimensions.name: document-density-detection
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = explicitly names that all four sections repeat the same earned paratactic closer and treats that repetition itself as the problem; 3 = notes some repetition but still endorses keeping all four; 1 = evaluates each closer in isolation and keeps them all, missing the document-level pattern.

graded_dimensions.name: earned-instance-respect
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = correctly classifies each individual closer as earned by its own evidence; 3 = hedges on whether the individual lines are earned; 1 = wrongly flags an individual earned closer as decorative or guts it.

evals.prompt: Rewrite without AI slop, or cut if there is no real content: It turns out that most teams struggle with alignment. The uncomfortable truth is that nobody wants to admit they're confused.
evals.expected_output: Removes the throat-clearing ('It turns out that', 'The uncomfortable truth is that') and either compresses to the plain claim or, because the source supplies no mechanism or evidence, marks the missing specifics as ask-author rather than inventing them.
assertions: Removes the throat-clearing openers ('It turns out that', 'The uncomfortable truth is that') and the hedge 'most'.
Does not invent a specific cause, number, team, or mechanism the source never supplies; either keeps the plain claim or flags the missing specifics (ask-author / cut).
Does not substitute a new punchy aphorism (e.g. 'Nobody admits confusion.') that adds cadence without adding a named mechanism or evidence.
Introduces no fact absent from the prompt, its source input, and the facts block; questions and explicitly marked unknowns are allowed.

graded_dimensions.name: non-invention
